description: Create a manual time entry with an explicit start time and duration (no live timer needed). Optionally tie it to a task, user, billable flag and tags. Returns the created entry. Use to log time after the fact.

assignee.description: User id the entry belongs to (defaults to the token owner).

billable.description: If true, mark the time as billable.

duration.description: Length of the interval in milliseconds.

start.description: Start time of the interval (natural language, ISO, or epoch ms).

tags.description: Array of time-entry tag objects to attach.

task_id.description: Task id to log the time against.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_time_entry
